# Demo Selenium Python for Google Maps

> A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in
> Python, teaching locator strategies and URL-based assertions for Google
> Maps. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its
> services — this code must never be executed against live Google Maps.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, run (do-not-run caution), and troubleshooting instructions.
- [Spec](./spec/index.md): Single source of truth for the exact three checks and selectors.
- [Citation](./CITATION.cff): How to cite this software.

## Source

- [demo.py](./src/demo.py): The Selenium WebDriver demo script itself (read-only reference; do not execute against live Google Maps).

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI coding agents working in
  this repo, including the non-negotiable do-not-run policy.
